source.title: Noradrenergic suppression of synaptic transmission may influence cortical signal-to-noise ratio

confidence_rationale: The cleanest cellular analogue in the pull of 'NA weakens internally generated constraint relative to incoming input': NE suppresses intrinsic (recurrent, associative) synapses more strongly than afferent synapses, and a model shows this shifts representations toward extrinsic input. Confidence is capped because the effect is shared with carbachol (so it does not separate NA from ACh, which MECH-084 explicitly does), because bath perfusion is a tonic manipulation rather than the phasic pulse MECH-084 is about, and because piriform intrinsic fibres are not the same thing as E2-to-E1 top-down feedback.
failure_signatures: The laminar selectivity (intrinsic > afferent suppression) is reproduced by the cholinergic agonist carbachol with matching dose-response, and combined NE+carbachol behaves like a single agonist -- the mechanism does not by itself distinguish NA from ACh, whereas MECH-084 assigns the orienting role to NA and the map-trace role to ACh (MECH-083).
Norepinephrine was bath-perfused, a sustained (tonic-like) manipulation; the paper gives no evidence that a transient phasic pulse produces the same intrinsic/afferent rebalancing.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In rat piriform cortex slices, norepinephrine causes dose-dependent suppression of excitatory synaptic potentials at intrinsic (pyramidal-pyramidal, layer Ib) synapses with a weaker effect on afferent (layer Ia) synapses; in a model this reduces activity dependent on intrinsic spread of excitation ('interpretation or retrieval') relative to activity driven by direct afferent input, enhancing the influence of extrinsic input on cortical representations.
mapping.ree_translation: A cellular candidate for MECH-084's 'high NA reduces E2's constraining influence on E1': NA preferentially weakens the internally generated, associative/predictive contribution to a representation while sparing the bottom-up afferent drive, so the representation is pulled toward the current input. The authors' own reframing of 'noise' as interpretation/retrieval is close to REE's top-down prior.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Intrinsic associative fibres within olfactory cortex are a local recurrent pathway, not an inter-module E2-to-E1 feedback channel; the manipulation is tonic bath application, not a phasic pulse; and carbachol produces the same effect, so the NA/ACh division of labour in MECH-084 is not supported by this mechanism.
mapping.source_context: Rat piriform cortex brain slices (extracellular synaptic potentials), plus a biophysical network model of piriform cortex.

confidence_components.notes: J Neurophysiol, classic and repeatedly cited laminar result; slice + model. Mapping is architectural-analogue only; transfer from olfactory recurrent synapses to a cortical feedback hierarchy is uncertain.
